tables.name: communication_msg_drafts
columns: body_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in TEXT,HTML
state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in GENERATED,EXPORTED,RECONCILED_SENT
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK revision>=1

tables.name: communication_msg_draft_recipients
columns: msg_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_msg_drafts
role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK in TO,CC,BCC

tables.name: communication_msg_draft_exports
columns: msg_draft_id TEXT NOT NULL FK communication_msg_drafts

rules: draft rows never contribute to received/sent communication counts or source coverage
later sent-store discovery creates/uses canonical Communication identity and may link reconciled_communication_id without merging draft identity
export location is operator-managed evidence and may be unavailable; raw path is not required in audit/diagnostics
